Netflix Zuul Event Bus
Topics: content.changed, user.updated,
catalog.price_changed
Delivery: at-least-once, timeout-based
subscriber degradation

span.p:
Key insight: service-owned caches with event-driven
coordination. Each service is responsible for its own
cache but subscribes to external events for invalidation.
